niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want a Jungian, therapeutic, or explicitly religious approach. Based on the available course information, these are good starting points:

### Shadow work
- **[Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/course/encounters-with-the-shadow)** — A focused introduction to Jungian ideas, with videos, audio, and a companion guide. A good pick if you want a psychologically grounded framework rather than a broad spiritual program.
- **[Embracing the Shadow — Awake Academy](https://www.awakeacademy.org/course/embracing-the-shadow/)** — A more extensive self-paced course; its listed topics include ancestral and sexual shadows. Consider whether those subjects feel appropriate for you before enrolling.
- **[Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate Your Shadow Self — Udemy](https://www.udemy.com/course/shadow_work/)** — A lower-cost, beginner-oriented option with journaling and self-guided exercises. The instructor’s background is in spiritual teaching, Reiki, and tarot, so it may suit you if you want an explicitly spiritual rather than clinical approach.

### Spiritual practice
- **[Contemplative Outreach online courses](https://www.contemplativeoutreach.org/live-and-self-guided-online-courses/)** — A strong option for Christian contemplative prayer and building a regular practice, including retreats and self-guided offerings.
- **[Shalem Institute offerings](https://shalem.org/programs/offerings-by-shalem-graduates/)** — Online courses drawing on contemplative practices from multiple faith traditions; some include private sessions.
- **[Spirituality & Practice e-courses](https://www.spiritualityandpractice.com/ecourses/course)** — A broad catalog, including interspiritual meditation, if you want to explore practices across traditions.
- **[Theama Institute: Journey Into Christian Mysticism](https://www.theamainst.org/journey-into-christian-mysticism)** — A structured live course with classes, exercises, meditations, and printable materials.

**My short list:** Jung Platform for a concise Jungian introduction; Awake Academy for a deeper shadow-work course; Shalem or Spirituality & Practice for a broader contemplative practice; Contemplative Outreach for Christian prayer.

Before paying, check the current syllabus, instructor qualifications, refund policy, and whether the course offers live support. Shadow work can bring up difficult memories or emotions; it isn’t a substitute for therapy. If you have a history of trauma or feel overwhelmed, choose a course with qualified support—or work with a licensed mental-health professional.
